+title: Router holds a HookDispatcher and emits the session, prompt and compaction events
+---
+## Discuss first
+This card is a Router change for the hook system that was designed in a FoundationModelsACPAgent session (2026-10-19). Discuss it with the user before implementation starts. Precondition: `swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsHooks` is on GitHub, with its events, `HookVisitor` and `HookDispatcher` (cards on the FoundationModelsHooks board).
+
+## What
+Router holds one `HookDispatcher` and emits the session, prompt and compaction events of `FoundationModelsHooks` for each `RoutedSession` on each slot (main, flash, a sub-agent, a fork, a model-switch replacement). The tool events are a different card. Each Router host gets hooks, not only the ACP agent.
+
+- `Package.swift`: add `FoundationModelsHooks` as a remote family dependency on `main`, with the same convention as the other family packages.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Router.swift`: add `hooks: HookDispatcher? = nil` to `Router.init` (line 120). Give it to each `RoutedLLM` and each session that `RoutedLLM.makeSession(configuration:)` (`RoutedLLM.swift:101`) makes. When `hooks` is `nil` or `isEmpty`, emit nothing and do no work.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Session/SessionConfiguration.swift`: add the lineage of a session for hooks: `hookSessionKey: String?` and `hookOrigin: SessionOrigin?`. A host sets them for a model-switch replacement (the key of the replaced session, `.replacement`). Default: the key is the session `id`, or the key of the parent for a fork or a child session (`parentCall`, line 156). Build the `HookSession` from the session `id`, the key, the parent id and the working directory.
+- Emit, all as post events (`dispatcher.post`, not awaited) unless written "pre":
+  - `SessionStart` when a session is made, resumed or forked (`RoutedSessionActorForking.swift:22`).
+  - `SessionEnd` in `close()` (`RoutedSessionActorForking.swift:382`), one time only.
+  - **pre** `PrePrompt` in the mail pump before delivery to the model (`RoutedSessionActorPump.swift:84`, `mailArrived`). NOT in `mail(_:)` or `send(_:)`, because they are sync. `.blocked`: do not deliver the mail, end it, and emit `PostPrompt` with `blocked(reason)`. `.proceed(e)` or `.approved(e)`: deliver `e.text`.
+  - `PostPrompt` at `answered`, `answerFailed` and `cancelled` for the mail.
+  - `CompactionStarted` and `CompactionEnded` in `performCompaction`, next to the `compactionStarted`, `compaction` and `compactionFailed` session events (`RoutedSessionActorCompaction.swift:301`).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] With no dispatcher, the Router tests pass unchanged, and no hook code runs.
+- [ ] A recording visitor gets `SessionStart`, `PrePrompt`, `PostPrompt` and `SessionEnd` in order for one prompt on a scripted session.
+- [ ] A fork gets `origin: .forked`, the key of the parent and `parentSessionID`.
+- [ ] A session with `hookSessionKey: "k"` and `hookOrigin: .replacement` gets the key `k`.
+- [ ] A visitor that blocks `PrePrompt` stops the delivery: the model gets no pass, and `PostPrompt` is `blocked`.
+- [ ] A visitor that replaces `PrePrompt.text` makes the model and the transcript get the new text.
+- [ ] A compaction gives `CompactionStarted` and then `CompactionEnded`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/HookEmissionTests.swift` (Swift Testing): each criterion above, with a scripted model from `FoundationModelsRouterTestSupport`, and `dispatcher.drain()` before each assertion on post events.
+- [ ] Run `swift test` in `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsRouter`. All tests pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd`. Write the failing tests first, then implement. #hooks #discuss
\ No newline at end of file
